say:1:1130531001:1.text: Tuktu went to Alkali to buy food and supplies. We're going to celebrate when he gets back!
say:1:1130531001:1.source_cn: 图克图去咸水镇买粮食和物资了，我们准备好好庆祝一下！
say:1:1130531001:1.male: Tuktu went to Alkali to buy food and supplies. We're going to celebrate when he gets back!
say:1:1130531001:1.female: Tuktu went to Alkali to buy food and supplies. We're going to celebrate when he gets back!

say:2:1130531002:1.text: With the Claws disbanded, we can start to think about heading back to our settlement.
say:2:1130531002:1.source_cn: 只要流沙之爪不再来，就不用提防骚扰，我们就可以搬回聚落了。
say:2:1130531002:1.male: With the Claws disbanded, we can start to think about heading back to our settlement.
say:2:1130531002:1.female: With the Claws disbanded, we can start to think about heading back to our settlement.

say:3:1130531003:1.text: It's all thanks to that hero.
say:3:1130531003:1.male: It's all thanks to that hero.
say:3:1130531003:1.female: It's all thanks to that hero.

choice_prompt:4:1130531003.female: It's all thanks to that hero.

say:5:1130531004:1.text: But you look so gentle, definitely not like a swordsman... are you a mage?
say:5:1130531004:1.source_cn: 你斯斯文文的，怎么看也不像是舞刀弄枪的，难道你是魔法师？
say:5:1130531004:1.male: But you look so gentle, definitely not like a swordsman... are you a mage?
say:5:1130531004:1.female: But you look so gentle, definitely not like a swordsman... are you a mage?

say:6:1130531005:1.text: Whether it was you or not, you're a guest as far as I'm concerned. Tonight, eat and drink your fill!
say:6:1130531005:1.source_cn: 不管是不是你吧，只要来了都是客人，到了晚上，吃喝管够！
